_about: Writer-realistic gold: what a writer actually inputs — summary + descriptors + pov/tense, plus (similar/ambiguous) an intensity ARC classified from the target scene's real vdi_curve. NO facets (subject/verb/object/svos). 3 variants per scene: similar (detailed), ambiguous (general language, same plot), sparse (general language, 1-2 major beats, no arc). 55 scenes x 3 = 165 queries. Target = target_scene_id.
